name: Mayhem
storyline: On your spaceship, a rather unpleasant person has decided to place a little NUCLEAR DEVICE. Just to add to the confusion, he’s thrown the digits for the combination in some of the 128 rooms on your ship. You had better find them fast, otherwise it’s a very long walk home.
summary: A 2D maze action game developed by Mark Incley and published by The Power House for ZX Spectrum. The player has to defuse a timer controlled nuclear device which the infamous space pirate Sniggin has placed on a large four-decked spacecraft.
